response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_matched_scans FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.riskeval ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC LIMIT 10
